ai_summary: Bajaj Housing Finance Limited reported strong provisional Q2 FY27 results, with gross disbursements increasing 25% year-over-year to ₹19,930 crore and Assets Under Management (AUM) growing 25% to ₹1,58,190 crore, indicating significant business expansion. These robust figures suggest healthy lending activity and market position, though it is important to note they are provisional and subject to statutory auditor review.
